text: The 10-working-day window of R-DS-40 is a durable workflow timer inside DebtSaleWorkflow, started from the rejection's decided-at time and read at the package's version; the story registers no Temporal Schedule, no Quartz job and no shared job table.
why: R-DS-40 carries a 10-working-day timer, DP-10 replaces Quartz with a Temporal Schedule or an event-started workflow, and a window that starts from a rule outcome and ends at a customer event is a workflow timer, not a calendar. D-RCV-60 retires the Quartz scheduler and the pattern set of this key carries no DP-10 row, so a Schedule would be a new, unowned platform element.
